name: write_post
description: Output one part of a multi-part blog series.

title.description: Concise, engaging title for THIS part, without a 'Part N:' prefix (ordering is tracked separately)

summary.description: One or two sentence description of this part

tags.description: 3-5 specific, descriptive lowercase tags. Include the core technology, the domain, and the angle. Keep them consistent with the rest of the series. Avoid vague tags like 'strategy' or 'tips'.

image_query.description: A 2-4 word Unsplash search query for a hero photo that visually represents this part's theme. Concrete and visual.

content.description: Full part body in Markdown, 700-1100 words (tight, no padding), written as a chapter of the series. Must: open with a short 'where we are' orientation that recalls earlier parts by name (or frames the series in Part 1); use ## sections that build sequentially; include fenced code blocks with language tags where relevant; include a key-takeaways callout (> 🧭 Key takeaways) near the end; and close with a one-to-two sentence teaser for the next part (or a short conclusion tying the series together if this is the final part). Do NOT include any Mermaid diagram. Use a Markdown table only for a genuine multi-row comparison — never to decorate; zero tables is fine. Mix prose, lists, and code so no more than 3 plain paragraphs run together.
